source_name: PSP/e-commerce comparison guides (cityhost, KITAPP, solomono, buh.ua)
why_relevant: Merchant-facing comparison articles enumerate the live PSP set (LiqPay, Portmone, Fondy, WayForPay, Interkassa, EasyPay, PROSTIR, 4bill) with fee structures — a cheap, continuously refreshed roster for building the actor map and spotting new entrants/exits.

source_name: PayAtlas — Ukraine country and company profiles
why_relevant: English-language structured profiles of Ukrainian PSPs and acceptance methods, including per-company pages (e.g. IBoxBank). Useful for cross-checking English names and for a foreign-analyst view of the acceptance landscape.

source_name: European Business Association (EBA Ukraine) — member payment news
why_relevant: Publishes member companies' commercial announcements, including payment-terminal network partnerships (e.g. Raben Ukraine adopting the iBox terminal system). Surfaces private-sector payment-acceptance deals that are never tendered publicly.

source_name: ua-region.com.ua — company registry mirror (EDRPOU lookups)
why_relevant: Free EDRPOU-keyed company profiles (e.g. EDRPOU 34046074 for iBox payment terminals). EDRPOU codes are the join key between company identity and Prozorro buyer/supplier records, so this is infrastructure for the whole cell.

source_name: Local investigative city media (Galka.if.ua, NGP-UA Khmelnytskyi, Firtka)
why_relevant: Regional outlets do the hardest-to-replicate work in this cell: naming the companies behind city e-ticket schemes and validator supplies, and flagging cases where operator selection was advertised in local newspapers rather than through Prozorro — precisely the demand that keyword monitoring of Prozorro cannot see.

source_name: Forbes Ukraine — fuel retail network rankings
why_relevant: Ranks the ten largest fuel-station networks (OKKO, WOG, Ukrnafta, SOCAR, UPG and others) by share of the ~70% concentrated fuel market. Fuel retail is one of the biggest non-bank acquiring and self-service terminal buyers, so this ranking prioritises which private buyers to track.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — payment acceptance and automation coverage
why_relevant: Mainstream Ukrainian finance portal that publishes merchant-oriented reviews of payment-acceptance and reporting-automation solutions, naming the acquirers and PSPs competing for retail/HoReCa acceptance spend.

source_name: Servus Systems Integration (ТОВ «Сервус Сістемз Інтегрейшн») — corporate site, solutions and clients
why_relevant: Long-standing Ukrainian integrator for ATMs, POS terminals, self-service kiosks and queue-management. Its solution/client pages name banks it equips — deals that rarely surface in ProZorro because most acquirers are private banks. Also a direct competitor-field marker.

source_name: CS Ltd (компанія CS) — core banking Б2/B2 product and implementation references
source_subtype: software vendor site (products, case references, news)
why_relevant: Dominant Ukrainian core-banking vendor (АБС Б2, iB2 card servicing). Product and reference pages state which banks run Б2 and which modules were implemented (e.g. long-running OTP Bank cooperation), giving a de facto core-banking install-base map for Ukraine.

source_name: UNITY-BARS — banking software vendor, products and clients
why_relevant: Ukrainian banking software house (ABS BARS core banking, COPR2/Corplight internet & mobile banking, credit and DWH modules). Product/customer pages identify which Ukrainian banks run its stack — supply-side evidence of deals invisible in registers.

source_name: ProFIX (ПРОФІКС) — payments/SWIFT solutions vendor, news and bank testimonials
why_relevant: SWIFT Business Partner and payments-software vendor serving Ukrainian banks; site carries dated news items and explicit bank testimonials (Raiffeisen Bank, Oschadbank money-transfer system serving ~2500 branches). Directly names deals and go-lives.

source_name: Ukrainian Processing Center (UPC / Український процесінговий центр) — company news
why_relevant: Largest independent card processor in Ukraine (RBI group). Its newsroom announces bank-client onboardings, new platforms (first Ukrainian Open Banking platform) and technology-partner selections (Tietoevry) — i.e. supply-side disclosure of contracts with banks.

source_name: Tietoevry Banking newsroom — Ukraine-related press releases
why_relevant: International vendor newsroom that published the UPC open-banking partnership — the canonical, dated, first-party record of a Ukrainian deal. Model case for monitoring foreign vendor newsrooms for 'won contract with Ukrainian bank' announcements.

source_name: SI BIS — Ukrainian system integrator, projects and partner list
why_relevant: One of the largest Ukrainian integrators (IBM-centric), 200+ infrastructure projects including financial-sector clients. Project/partner pages enumerate both bank customers and the OEM brands it resells — a bidder profile for infrastructure tenders.

source_name: IT-Integrator (ІТ-Інтегратор) — corporate site and case studies
source_subtype: integrator corporate site (cases, news, vendor partnerships)
why_relevant: Self-described largest Ukrainian IT solutions provider for corporate and state sectors; publishes cases including bank infrastructure work. Frequent bidder on state-bank (Oschadbank, Ukrgasbank, PrivatBank) infrastructure tenders.

source_name: БМС Консалтінг / БМС Сервіс group — integrator supplying Ukrainian state banks
source_subtype: company registry profile + investigative reporting on vendor
why_relevant: The BMS group is a recurrent supplier of datacentre/hardware to Ukrainian state banks (reported Oschadbank Dell data-centre contract ~UAH 223m). Registry/journalistic profiles of the group act as supply-side identification of who wins big bank infrastructure deals, and the related entities (БМС Сервіс, БМС-Лайн Сервіс) reveal the contracting structure.

source_name: Softline IT Ukraine (softline.kiev.ua) — news and banking-integration articles
why_relevant: Integrator active since 1995 publishing project write-ups, including ERP/Dynamics 365 integration with the banking systems of three major banks — a class of deal never visible in tender registers.

source_name: Printec Ukraine (printec.com.ua) — banking self-service supplier site
why_relevant: Regional supplier of ATM/self-service and payment-terminal technology and services for Ukrainian banks; site and news announce certifications and partnerships (e.g. first certified Checkbox partner for Castles S1F2 Android terminal), signalling product lines being pushed into the Ukrainian market.

source_name: SystemGroup Ukraine — self-service kiosks and banking/retail automation catalogue
why_relevant: Distributor/integrator of self-service kiosks and payment hardware in Ukraine; catalogue pages reveal which OEM brands are actually available locally and at what positioning — a supply-availability map for kiosk/ATM-adjacent tenders.

source_name: Бан Ком Сервіс (bankomservice.com.ua) — banking equipment dealer
why_relevant: Specialist Ukrainian dealer of banking equipment (cash counters, ATM parts, safes, cash-handling). Its catalogue and brand list identify the second tier of suppliers who bid on bank equipment lots and service contracts.

source_name: GeneralPay — Ingenico terminal partner in Ukraine
why_relevant: Declares itself an Ingenico partner supplying POS terminals in Ukraine with integration and service support — an example of the OEM-to-local-partner chain in acquiring hardware, and a pointer to which terminal families are being pushed to Ukrainian acquirers.

source_name: Sense Bank acquiring help-centre — POS terminal models used by the bank
why_relevant: Demand-side page that reveals supply: the bank publicly lists the exact terminal models it deploys (Verifone vx520/VX200T/vx675/V240M, PAX Q80/S920, Ingenico Move 2500, Desk 2600). Equivalent pages at other acquirers let one reconstruct each bank's hardware vendor mix without any tender document.

source_name: «Мережі та Бізнес» — annual Ukrainian system-integrator ranking (SI Ukraine)
why_relevant: Trade-press ranking that enumerates the entire Ukrainian system-integrator field with revenue and specialisation — the single best pointer for building the bidder universe for bank IT tenders, and for spotting new entrants year over year.

source_name: Shelfy — Ukrainian system-integrator company directory
why_relevant: Directory listing integrators active in Ukraine with profiles — cheap way to enumerate mid/small integrators absent from the trade rankings, then snowball to their client pages.
